description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partner For Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale No. 55 College Green, an outstanding  three-bedroom family residence that is exquisitely designed throughout and features an expansive floor area of 125 square meters. 

The owner’s passion for interior design is evident at every turn, with her skill and attention to detail reflected in every room of this beautifully presented home.

On arrival, you are greeted by an immaculate entrance hall featuring a striking two-tone staircase with modern flooring. This leads through to a wonderfully designed contemporary living room, where eye-catching wall panelling and premium fixtures and fittings create a stylish and inviting space.

The kitchen and dining area is a study in contemporary design, featuring a Scandinavian-inspired two-tone kitchen, contrasting wood countertops, built-in appliances and a cleverly considered layout. The combination of carefully chosen finishes and practical design makes this a superb space for everyday family living.

A fully equipped utility room provides access to the exquisite garden beyond. Here, a generous patio area, pergola, beautiful planting and modern fencing create an attractive setting for relaxing and entertaining. A brick pathway leads to a storage shed, completing this thoughtfully arranged outdoor space.

A delightfully styled and spacious guest WC completes the accommodation on the ground floor.

Upstairs, a large landing features striking wall panelling, premium wood flooring and an abundance of floor space. This leads to an exceptional main bedroom with generous proportions, modern wide-plank flooring, ample built-in storage and a fully remodelled en suite.

A further large double bedroom is located to the rear of the property, while the third double bedroom is currently arranged as an office and lounge area, offering excellent flexibility to suit a variety of needs.

The family bathroom has been upgraded to an exceptional standard, featuring contrasting modern tiling, ultra-contemporary fixtures and fittings, and attractive herringbone flooring.

The home is highly energy efficient and  benefits from a B3 BER.

To the front the property offers an attractive brick driveway featuring deal parking along with a recently installed  EV charger.

If you are looking for an outstanding home that is wonderfully located and exquisitely styled, look no further than No. 55 College Green, as it is certain to exceed your expectations.

If this sounds like you, we would be delighted to hear from you and show you around.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property, your trusted experts for residential property sales.
